verdict.rationale: Retell documents a Press Digit tool that lets single- or multi-prompt agents send DTMF keypad digits to navigate IVR menus, but only in the context of outbound calls. Nothing in the pack covers detecting voicemail or leaving voicemail messages, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: voicemail detection, leaving voicemail, DTMF/IVR scope beyond outbound calls, independent or hands-on corroboration of IVR navigation.
